summary: Check results with cat /tmp/switch-facts and find /tmp/backups, and use the network troubleshooting guide if the playbook fails.
questions: How do I check the results of the network facts playbook?

answer_card.title: Check facts demo results
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
cat /tmp/switch-facts
find /tmp/backups
```
If the run fails, follow the network debug and troubleshooting guide.
